    The structured answer of the native app readiness endpoint.

    NativeReadinessService
    Runs the native app readiness checks for one configured relying party: feature gate, lookup, RP ID validation, per-RP result cache, rate limits, then the reachability and content checks.
    NativeReadinessService.NotFound
    The requested relying party is not configured.
    NativeReadinessService.RateLimited
    A rate limit refused the request; NativeReadinessService.RateLimited.retryAfterSeconds() says when to ask again.
    ReachabilityChecker
    Decides whether a relying party's association files are reachable the way Android and iOS need them: answered with 200 by the RP ID host itself, with a JSON content type, within the size and time limits.
    ReachabilityReport
    Reachability checks for one association file, together with the fetch they were derived from.
    ReadinessRateLimiter
    Bounds how much outbound work the readiness endpoint can cause, per node.

    Decides whether a relying party ID may be used to build an outbound URL.
    RpIdValidator.Rejection
    Why a value was rejected.

    Outcome of RpIdValidator.validate(String): either an accepted ID or a rejection reason.
    ValidatedRpId
    A relying party ID that RpIdValidator accepted: a normalized, lower-case, ASCII DNS hostname.
